engine.title: Auto-Invite Engine
engine.description: Automatically notify eligible students when a spot opens in a class.
engine.automaticNotificationsDescription: Notify students automatically when attendance is confirmed
engine.invitationModeDescription: Send replacement invitations automatically, or ask for your approval first
engine.remindersHint: Automatically remind students before class and ask them to confirm attendance.
engine.invitationGroupsHint: Define who gets invited and in what order. Each group is tried in sequence — if no one accepts from Group 1, the system moves to Group 2.
engine.tiebreakersHint: How to rank players within each group. Higher items take priority.
engine.standingWaitingListHint: Add students to the waiting list for all upcoming classes. They are automatically removed once they fill the configured number of spots or the period expires.

reminders.firstReminderDescription: When to send the first attendance reminder before class.
reminders.remindersPerStudentDescription: How many reminders to send if the student doesn't respond.
reminders.hoursBetweenDescription: How long to wait before sending the next reminder.
reminders.startInvitationsDescription: When to begin inviting replacements for open spots.

invitationGroups.sequenceHint: Groups are tried in sequence. If no one in Group 1 accepts, the system moves to Group 2, and so on.
invitationGroups.noRules: No rules — open to all players.
invitationGroups.lastGroupHint: Tip: Your last group has filters. Add an empty group at the end to allow any player as a last resort.

restrictions.maxSimultaneousDescription: How many students are notified at the same time
restrictions.maxTotalDescription: Total notifications sent for one open spot
restrictions.maxInactiveTimeDescription: Minutes to wait before sending the next batch if no one responds
restrictions.minTimeBeforeClassDescription: Don't notify if class starts within X minutes
restrictions.excludedPlayersDescription: Specific players to exclude from all automatic invitations.
restrictions.excludeUnpaidDescription: Don't invite students with an inactive or unpaid subscription
restrictions.cancellationDeadlineDescription: Cancellations within this many hours before class start are flagged as late

notificationGroups.sameLevel: Students with the same level as the class
notificationGroups.recentAbsences: Students who missed a class recently
notificationGroups.justifiedAbsences: Students with at least one justified absence
notificationGroups.allStudents: All eligible students not already in the class

standingList.empty: No students on the standing waiting list.

descriptions.invite: Sent when notifying a student about an open spot.
descriptions.confirm: Sent automatically when a student says Yes.
descriptions.decline: Sent automatically when a student says No.
descriptions.spotFilled: Sent when a spot is claimed before the student responds.
descriptions.reminder: Sent to remind students before class and ask them to confirm attendance.
descriptions.reminderFollowup: Sent if the student hasn't responded to the first reminder.
descriptions.reminderConfirmed: Sent automatically when a student confirms attendance.
descriptions.reminderDeclined: Sent automatically when a student declines attendance.
descriptions.waitingListOffer: Sent when a spot was filled, offering to be placed on the waiting list.
descriptions.waitingListPlaced: Sent when a waiting-list student gets a spot.
